ctx.x: I see. Oh. Yeah, yeah, he makes a distinction between the 1917 and the 1922. I'm sorry. I was running it together here, trying to read fast. He said he'd "often seen my brother-in-law, Bill Johnson"--is that Dink Johnson?
No, Bill Johnson was a...Dink Johnson's brother.
I see. There were two brothers.
